mapper.select: SELECT A.GRADE_NO AS GRADE_NO, A.MODIFICATION_DATE AS MODIFICATION_DATE, A.PERIOD_NO AS PERIOD_NO, A.REGISTRATION_DATE AS REGISTRATION_DATE, A.RESUME_CONTENT AS RESUME_CONTENT, A.RESUME_DEL_FL AS RESUME_DEL_FL, A.RESUME_DEL_FL AS RESUME_HIDE_FL, A.RESUME_NO AS RESUME_NO, A.RESUME_TITLE AS RESUME_TITLE, A.SALARY_AMOUNT AS SALARY_AMOUNT, A.SALARY_NO AS SALARY_NO, A.WORKER_NO AS WORKER_NO, ( SELECT LISTAGG(D.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_INFO, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY D.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO) FROM WORKCOND_ADDRESS B JOIN WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE D ON B.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO = D.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO WHERE B.RESUME_NO = A.RESUME_NO ) AS WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_INFO, ( SELECT NVL(SUM( CASE WHEN E.END_DATE IS NULL THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) - TRUNC(E.START_DATE) ELSE TRUNC(E.END_DATE) - TRUNC(E.START_DATE) END ), 0) FROM RESUME_CAREER C JOIN CAREER_INFO E ON C.CAREER_NO = E.CAREER_NO WHERE C.RESUME_NO = A.RESUME_NO ) AS TOTAL_CAREER, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT B.RECRUITMENT_NO) FROM WORKCOND_ADDRESS B WHERE B.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO IN ( SELECT DISTINCT F.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO FROM WORKCOND_ADDRESS F WHERE F.RESUME_NO = A.RESUME_NO ) AND B.RECRUITMENT_NO IS NOT NULL ) AS RECOMMENDATION FROM RESUME A WHERE A.WORKER_NO = #{workerNo} AND A.RESUME_DEL_FL = 'N' ORDER BY A.RESUME_NO DESC
